title: 第八章枯木村
novel_title: 开局阴阳宗，从反杀师姐开始斩妖除魔
content_zh:
张守安接下纸张，收回衣物之中。

    不管怎么说，总归要去看看，查查线索。

    疤爷似是看出了张守安的意思，站起身来劝道：

    “我先说清楚，那里最近闹妖患，可不算太平。”

    张守安一听，手上的动作顿时僵硬了几秒。

    不过这一细微的动作却是都进入了疤爷眼里。

    果然，他也不敢去……

    他叹了口气，如今这一波新入宗门的怎么回事，修炼了这么久，连几只妖都怕，能成什么事情。

    各个都是窝囊废。

    可就在他转身准备送客之时，对面的那个男子却是突然抬起头看来，看着自己，目光炯炯。

    就好像特别的——激动。

    这对吗？

    张守安心里的激动已经写在了脸上，他本来以为疤爷让他去村里最多就是问问情报，查查线索什么的。

    结果是让他杀妖！

    不过，对方好像也没说要杀，就是提醒自己要小心一点，但那样不是白去了。

    我拿什么满足我的道行值，他现在都那么空虚了。

    所以自己必须去看看。

    ……

    枯木村

    隶属于阴阳门之下，民风淳朴，荒凉凋敝，数十年前常有妖患不断，最近几年，倒是少了许多。

    田间杂草不断，里面并未种植作物，田地早已干裂开来。

    房屋破损大半，泥质的墙体也脱落掉大部分。

    村里的人们漫无目的地在街上走着，他们衣物破烂，身子枯瘦。

    张守安在离开茶馆后，找了一件衣物换上，虽未多么豪华，但在这里的村民之间，已经可以用奢侈来形容了。

    当他走进村子时，那些村民纷纷看了过来，目光涣散。

    待看清楚张守安的装扮后，便赶紧移开目光，就像是在躲避着什么。

    张守安微微蹙眉，走近了最近的一位男子身边，他此刻正在精心编织着草帽，全然没有注意到身后的来人。
content_en:
Zhang Shouan took the paper and put it back into his clothes.

No matter what, I have to go take a look and look for clues.

Mr. Scar seemed to see what Zhang Shouan meant, stood up and advised:

"Let me make it clear first, there has been a monster infestation there recently, and it is not a peaceful place."

Upon hearing this, Zhang Shou'an's hand movements froze for a few seconds.

However, this subtle movement caught Master Scar's eyes.

Sure enough, he didn't dare to go either...

He sighed, what's going on with this wave of newcomers to the sect? After practicing for so long, they are even afraid of a few monsters. What can they accomplish?

Everyone is a loser.

But just when he turned around to see off the guests, the man opposite suddenly raised his head and looked at him with bright eyes.

It's like special - exciting.

Is this right?

Zhang Shou'an's excitement was already written on his face. He originally thought that Master Scar would ask him to go to the village to ask for information and check for clues.

The result was that he was asked to kill the demon!

However, the other party didn't seem to say that he wanted to kill him, he just reminded himself to be careful, but that would not be in vain.

No matter what I do to satisfy my moral values, he is so empty now.

So you have to go and see for yourself.

…

Deadwood Village

Affiliated to the Yin Yang Sect, the folk customs are simple, desolate and desolate. A few decades ago, there were constant demon troubles, but in recent years, there have been a lot less of them.

There are constant weeds in the fields, no crops are planted in them, and the fields have long been dry and cracked.

Most of the house was damaged, and most of the mud walls had fallen off.

People in the village were walking aimlessly on the streets, their clothes were in tatters and their bodies were skinny.

After Zhang Shou'an left the teahouse, he found a piece of clothing to change into. Although it was not very luxurious, among the villagers here, it could already be described as luxurious.

When he walked into the village, the villagers looked over one after another, their eyes distracted.

After seeing Zhang Shou'an's outfit clearly, he quickly looked away, as if he was avoiding something.

Zhang Shou'an frowned slightly and approached the nearest man. He was carefully knitting a straw hat at the moment, completely unaware of the person coming behind him.
